_hinweis: Figuren- und Objektblatt für den Aquarellstil (docs/BILDSTIL.md, Abschnitt 4), abgeleitet aus den Pflichtmerkmalen des Bildlexikons; Farben gedeckt nach der Palette. Altersangaben sind Bildgestaltung (R), keine Textfakten.
stil_en: Very reduced, loose watercolour sketch for adults, like a quick painted study in a sketchbook – much simpler than a finished book illustration. Most of the sheet is untouched warm white paper. Only a few thin, broken ink lines that suggest forms instead of outlining them; many contours are left open or missing. Colour as a few flat, transparent, pale washes that bleed softly and do not fill the shapes completely; no shading, no modelling, no texture, no folds in the clothing, no patterns on fabric, no hair strands, no individual leaves or stones. Faces are simple: a few strokes for eyes, nose, mouth and beard – recognisable and expressive, but not detailed. Hands are simplified. Backgrounds are left out or reduced to one pale wash or a single line; at most one simple hint of the place. Crowds are only a few loosely suggested figures that fade into the paper. Small muted palette: sand, ochre, terracotta, blue-grey, olive, soft ink grey. Natural adult proportions. No photorealism, no anime, no glossy or cinematic light. First-century Galilee and Judea: plain garments and head coverings, sandals, earthenware, stone.
bild_en: Landscape picture, a single scene (not a comic page, no panel borders, no frame). No lettering of any kind and no speech bubbles. Keep the upper third of the picture as empty white paper, because speech bubbles are added there later. Use as few people and objects as the scene needs. Every person and every important object stands completely inside the picture with empty paper on every side; nobody is cut off by an edge; the washes fade out into the white paper towards the edges.

figuren.FIG-JESUS: Jesus: a Galilean man in his early thirties, shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair, short full dark beard, warm brown eyes, olive skin, a kind and open face that is always fully visible like everyone else's; cream linen tunic and a muted terracotta-red mantle over one shoulder. No halo. He is the only person wearing terracotta-red.
figuren.FIG-MARIA-MUTTER-JESU: Mary, the mother of Jesus: clearly one generation older than her adult son, grey streaks in her dark hair visible under the veil, gentle lines around eyes and mouth, slightly stooped posture; blue-grey veil and blue-grey robe.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-JUENGER: The disciples: a few young and middle-aged men with beards in plain ochre and brown belted robes, bare-headed, staying close to Jesus.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-DIENER: The servants: men and women of different ages in plain sand-coloured belted tunics with pale linen aprons, sleeves rolled up, bare-headed.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-SPEISEMEISTER: The master of the feast: a portly older man, grey beard, receding grey hair, bare-headed, in an olive-green robe with a wide ochre-gold belt.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-BRAEUTIGAM: The bridegroom: a young beardless or lightly bearded man in a muted violet festive robe with a wreath of small fresh flowers on his head.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-HAENDLER: Money changers and dove sellers: ordinary bearded men of different ages with plain undyed headcloths, dignified, never caricatured.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-MENGE: Jewish people of Jerusalem: men, women and children of different ages in everyday robes in sand, grey, blue-grey and white, some with simple plain head coverings; dignified and varied, never caricatured or stereotyped.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-KRUG-WASSER: Six large stone water jars: waist-high, heavy, plain, pale grey, clearly distinct from small clay pitchers.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-KRUG-WEIN-LEER: A small empty clay wine jug.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-BECHER-VOLL: A simple earthenware cup with red wine.
figuren.FIG-ORT-TEMPEL: The temple in Jerusalem: tall pale limestone building and colonnades, drawn lightly.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-PEITSCHE: A short whip made of a few knotted cords.

figurenblatt_en: A character reference sheet on warm white paper: the following people standing side by side in a row, full figure, front view, evenly spaced with white space between them, same scale, neutral standing pose, each face clearly visible. From left to right: Mary, Jesus, the master of the feast, the bridegroom, one male and one female servant, two disciples. No names, no lettering.
_hinweis_pruef: «kenn_en»: kurze Beschreibung, an der das Prüfmodell die Figur im Bild wiederfindet (ohne Namen). «pruef»: Figurenregeln, gelten in jedem Feld, in dem die Figur vorkommt (Aufbau wie pruefregeln.json).

kenn_en.FIG-JESUS: a man in his early thirties with dark wavy shoulder-length hair and short dark beard, wearing a cream tunic and a terracotta-red mantle
kenn_en.FIG-MARIA-MUTTER-JESU: an older woman in a blue-grey veil and blue-grey robe
kenn_en.FIG-GRUPPE-JUENGER: one or more bearded men in plain ochre or brown robes near the man in the terracotta-red mantle
kenn_en.FIG-GRUPPE-DIENER: servants in sand-coloured tunics with pale aprons
kenn_en.FIG-ROLLE-SPEISEMEISTER: a portly older man with grey beard in an olive-green robe with a wide ochre belt
kenn_en.FIG-ROLLE-BRAEUTIGAM: a young man in a violet robe with a small flower wreath on his head
kenn_en.FIG-ROLLE-HAENDLER: traders: dove sellers or money changers
kenn_en.FIG-GRUPPE-MENGE: a group of ordinary people (for a speaking group: the member who speaks)

FIG-JESUS.de: Gesicht Jesu sichtbar wie bei allen Menschen (von vorn, schräg oder im Profil; nicht abgewandt, verdeckt oder leer)
FIG-JESUS.en: Is the face of the man in the terracotta-red mantle visible with its features (eyes, nose, mouth as far as the angle shows them)? A front, three-quarter or profile view all count as visible; answer "no" only if the face is hidden, turned away from the viewer or left blank.

FIG-MARIA-MUTTER-JESU.de: Maria sichtbar eine Generation älter als Jesus
FIG-MARIA-MUTTER-JESU.en: Does the woman in the blue-grey veil look clearly a generation older than the man in the terracotta-red mantle (grey hair or lines on the face, like his mother)?

FIG-ROLLE-SPEISEMEISTER.en: Does the man in the olive-green robe look older, with a grey beard?

FIG-ROLLE-BRAEUTIGAM.en: Does the man in the violet robe look young and wear a small wreath?
